shortcutCaption: Show a WhatsApp button after any call ends

status.error: We couldn’t check this phone. Review access and try again.
status.needs-permission: Some access is still missing. Granting access alone does not enable automatic shortcuts.
status.unsupported: This build cannot verify the other caller’s number automatically. The shortcut stays off.
status.active: Automatic shortcut is on. The card appears only when Android supplies the call’s number; otherwise it stays hidden.
status.off: Access is ready. Turn on the automatic shortcut above to activate it.

manualCaption: Open WhatsApp without saving a contact
limitations: The card shows for one clean call session at a time; calls from saved contacts may not produce a number.
